answers.core: This is about improving the mobile development experience with Godot. This would also benefit the [official demo projects](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects) which would gain better support for touch controls, without having to import several copies of an add-on into the repository.
answers.workaround: A large portion of mobile games need a virtual joystick or two, which can't be implemented with a few lines of script (especially if good usability is desired).

title: Add a virtual joystick node to complement TouchScreenButton
